facts.value: Room in a shared apartment EUR 400-520/month; CU dormitory EUR 180 (shared room) or EUR 260 (private room) per month (CU estimate, page updated Feb 2026)
Private apartment EUR 720-1,000/month (CU estimate, 2026); 1-bedroom flat approx. CZK 22,000 (outside centre) to CZK 26,300 (centre) per month (Numbeo, Nov 2026)
facts.source_name: Charles University - Costs of Living; Numbeo (crowd-sourced)
facts.notes: CU says 'private apartment' without specifying size; Numbeo figure is crowd-sourced (2,673 entries in 12 months, last update 23 Nov 2026).

facts.value: About EUR 400-600/month living in a dormitory, EUR 600-1,000/month in private accommodation, rent included (CU estimate, 2026)
Student (18-26, full-time) Prague pass CZK 130/month, CZK 360/3 months, CZK 1,280/year; full price CZK 550/month (PID tariff valid from 10 Dec 2023)
Continental: average lows about -2 C and highs 2 C in January, highs about 26 C in July; winters mostly cloudy
facts.notes: Not checked against the Czech Hydrometeorological Institute (CHMI).

facts.value: Large international community: Charles University alone has over 11,000 international students, with buddy programmes and international student clubs
English is enough for English-taught (fee-paying) programmes; tuition-free study requires Czech-taught programmes. Many job portals listed by the city are Czech-only
facts.source_name: Charles University - Tuition Fees; Prague for All (City of Prague)

facts.value: Student jobs are usually on DPP agreements (max 300 h/year per employer); CU points to jobs.cz, faculty job boards and expat groups; CU recommends about 20 h/week during term
No citable source for typical student pay found. Legal floor: CZK 134.40/hour (2026), CZK 148.30/hour from 1 Jan 2027 (40-hour week)
facts.notes: CU case study assumes EUR 400/month from a part-time job (cuni.cz/UKEN-1619.html), which is an illustration, not a wage statistic.
